Our waiter was awesome, the staff also worked as a team in bringing and cleaning up our food. The food was fresh and awesome. Then we also had dessert and that was really good as well. Great atmosphere with really nice people.Must recommend for pure veg people

The other part that wasn`t ``great`` was the drinks - they literally said we are going to use dry ice for all our table side drinks and that`s how we`re going to get exciting presentation. For 1 or 2 drinks thats cool, but all six of us ordered different drinks and got some dry ice trick. Again, not bad, just overused.

Overall a great, great experience!

Small cozy place. Always crowded. Options on the menu are quite different and innovative. What I ordered is a pot rice. Unlike the traditional pot rice this came with a rich cashew gravy separately and the fried rice separately. The taste was more of a Indian Chinese fusion which was great for a change. Hygiene was observed at all times. Great food quality and quantity. Service boys are welcoming with a smile on their face. Overall good experience. Despite being busy no much waiting as the service is quite prompt and quick. Recommend this place. Will visit soon
